script: The rude guest's call turned my career upside down—find out why!. The day I got the call, I was in the middle of a coffee break, scrolling through my phone, when a guest on the line said, "Hey, I need to change something on my reservation." He was driving, so the background was all honks and engine rumble. I didn't catch the last letter of his last name—thought it was an S, not a C. (Micro‑hook: he's about to drop a bomb on me.) He corrected me, "It's a C, not an S." Then he muttered, "Fucking idiot." Honestly, I felt the heat. (I know, right?) That's when I remembered the policy: every Platinum+ member gets a free upgrade. He was a Platinum+ guest, so he'd already been bumped to the Presidential Suite for the night. But I had no idea. I went ahead and made the change he requested, but quietly slipped him back down to a standard room. I didn't even say anything about the suite. He never found out he'd lost the best room in the hotel because he decided to be a pompous ass. (Micro‑hook: the audacity of that guy.) Now I am sitting here, thinking about how the guy got the full experience, and I was the one who kept it. If he'd known, he'd have probably left a review about how rude I was. Instead, the hotel got a free upgrade, and I got a story that's still my favorite. Don't ever bite the hand that feeds you, bestie.
